description: Schéma directeur des infrastructures de recharge pour et hybrides rechargeables (Syndicat Départemental d'Energies et d'Electricité du Pays Catalan) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Syndicat Départemental d'Energies et d'Electricité du Pays Catalan. This dataset meets the specifications of the schema “Schema Director of Charging Infrastructures for Electric Vehicles and Plug-in Hybrids” available on schema.data.gouv.fr. Coverage: Syndicat Départemental d'Energies et d'Electricité du Pays Catalan. The portal shows the English title as "Blueprint for charging infrastructure for electric vehicles and plug-in hybrids (Syndicat Départemental d’Energies et d’" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Syndicat Départemental d'Energies et d'Electricité du Pays Catalan. Its keywords include irve, sdirve, pyrenees-orientales. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-07-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
